evidence.meaning: Each passage supports a required answer aspect. Both documents are needed to fully answer each two-document question. In q028, Article 3 and Article 10 of doc_id 141383 are alternative evidence for the same aspect. A chunk is relevant if it fully contains any annotated passage.

limitations: Completeness of alternative evidence labels is not guaranteed.
Source content is evaluated as provided; current legal validity is not verified.
Questions without document numbers may name source titles, years or locality.
No unanswerable cases; dev/test split not assigned.

evaluation_protocol.document_recall: Count distinct retrieved doc_ids intersecting distinct evidence doc_ids, divided by number of distinct evidence doc_ids. Restrict retrieved IDs to the first five chunks; do not refill after deduplication.
evaluation_protocol.chunk_relevance: Same doc_id and chunk.start_char <= evidence.start_char and chunk.end_char >= evidence.end_char for at least one evidence passage.
evaluation_protocol.hit: 1 if any relevant chunk is in top five, else 0.
evaluation_protocol.reciprocal_rank: 1 / first relevant chunk rank in top five, else 0. MRR is mean across questions.
evaluation_protocol.latency: Mean retrieval time including query embedding/API/network for dense and hybrid; exclude index loading, scoring metrics and writing outputs.
evaluation_protocol.caveat: Hit/MRR require at least one evidence passage, not complete coverage of both sources.
